stem.text: Two forces, each of magnitude $F$, act at points V and W on an object.
The two forces form a couple. The shape of the object is a right-angled triangle with sides of lengths $x$ and $y$, as shown.

stem.alt: Right-angled triangle with vertices labelled V at the top and W at the bottom. The side from V to W is labelled x, and the hypotenuse on the left is labelled y. Each of the two forces is labelled F: one acts at V pointing up and to the left along the side that meets V, the other acts at W pointing down and to the right. Right-angle marks are shown at the corners.

stem.text: Which expression gives the torque exerted by the couple?
